items.title: How to Rewrite Yourself
items.content_snippet: Shopify CEO Tobi Lütke used to be terrified of public speaking. To overcome it, he used a simple habit: writing out his goal in the present tense, as if it were already true, over and over again. Listen to the full episode to hear how Tobi uses affirmations to fast-track his goals.

items.title: 4 Ways Smart People Fool Themselves
items.content_snippet: Leon Rozenblit and Frank Keil at Yale asked people how well they understood everyday objects — a zipper, a flush toilet, a bicycle. Confidence was high. Then they asked for a step-by-step explanation of how the thing actually works. Confidence collapsed, immediately and often embarrassingly. items.title: LifeVal: Measuring AI progress on the tasks that matter in everyday life.
items.content_snippet: For AGI to benefit all of humanity, it should help people with the everyday tasks that matter most to them. So we built LifeVal, a new benchmark shaped by feedback from thousands of ChatGPT users on where they most want help from a personal assistant—from finding childcare to accessing government services and managing personal finances. Over the past year, we’ve used LifeVal to measure and improve how well our models handle these everyday tasks. https://openai.com/index/lifeval/
